g.text: which runs on its own I2C channel from the controller. Outputs drive the coil MOSFET gates (active high, 100k pull-downs

g.desc: which runs on its own I2C channel from the controller. Outputs drive the coil MOSFET gates (active high, 100k pull-downs

g.text: at each gate), so power-on, RESET and a lost bus leave every coil off. RESET = RLY_EN (active high, R3 pull-down on

g.desc: at each gate), so power-on, RESET and a lost bus leave every coil off. RESET = RLY_EN (active high, R3 pull-down on

g.text: the power sheet): no signal holds the expanders in reset and +12V_SW off. Documented exception: the datasheet asks

g.desc: the power sheet): no signal holds the expanders in reset and +12V_SW off. Documented exception: the datasheet asks

g.text: for a pull-up on RESET. Firmware: set RLY_EN high, then configure. Unused I/Os: set as outputs LOW by firmware.

g.desc: for a pull-up on RESET. Firmware: set RLY_EN high, then configure. Unused I/Os: set as outputs LOW by firmware.

g.text: EXP_INT (open drain) signals a change on the RFDET, K0_DRV and TX_ANY (PTT readback, D-53) inputs.

g.desc: EXP_INT (open drain) signals a change on the RFDET, K0_DRV and TX_ANY (PTT readback, D-53) inputs.

g.text: Bus pull-ups on this board, so unit 1 and unit 2 are the same (D-52): R901, R902 2.2k on SCL, SDA (bus about 100 pF max:

g.desc: Bus pull-ups on this board, so unit 1 and unit 2 are the same (D-52): R901, R902 2.2k on SCL, SDA (bus about 100 pF max:

g.text: rise 0.85 x 2.2k x 100 pF = 0.19 us, Fast-mode limit 0.3 us; sink 1.5 mA, PCA9539 IOL min 3 mA). R903 10k on EXP_INT.

g.desc: rise 0.85 x 2.2k x 100 pF = 0.19 us, Fast-mode limit 0.3 us; sink 1.5 mA, PCA9539 IOL min 3 mA). R903 10k on EXP_INT.

g.text: The controller board adds no pull-ups on this bus. Unit 2: J14 takes the EXP ribbon from the unit 1 controller board (D-53).

g.desc: The controller board adds no pull-ups on this bus. Unit 2: J14 takes the EXP ribbon from the unit 1 controller board (D-53).

g.text: R904 100k pull-down on TX_ANY: defined low with J14 open (logic verification F4, D-61).

g.desc: R904 100k pull-down on TX_ANY: defined low with J14 open (logic verification F4, D-61).
